master.definition_en: Inflammation of the bronchioles characterized by swelling of the bronchioles and mucus accumulation. It is usually caused by the respiratory syncytial virus and affects children. Signs and symptoms include coughing, wheezing, and shortness of breath.

curated.category: 婴幼儿急性下呼吸道感染
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 2岁以下（尤以6月龄以内小婴儿）最常见的急性下呼吸道梗阻急症，主要由呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）引起；炎性黏液栓塞细支气管可于数小时至1–2天内导致严重缺氧、二氧化碳潴留、呼吸暂停甚至呼吸衰竭死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 呈自限性急性过程（病程约1–2周），无特效抗RSV病毒药，但通过及时吸氧、气道湿化清理鼻涕痰液、补液及经鼻高流量/无创呼吸支持，绝大多数患儿可完全治愈；长效单抗尼塞韦单抗可有效预防约75%–83%的RSV住院。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Li等（The Lancet 2022）估算全球5岁以下儿童每年发生约3,300万例RSV相关急性下呼吸道感染（主要表现为毛细支气管炎与肺炎），造成约101,400例死亡（近半数发生在6月龄以内婴儿）。
annual_deaths_global.source: Li Y et al., The Lancet 2022

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国5岁以下儿童RSV-ALRI年发病率约40.3/1,000儿童，足月健康婴儿占住院绝对负担的90%以上，官方未单列急性毛细支气管炎独立死亡人数。
annual_deaths_china.source: China RSV Epidemiology / Li et al., Lancet 2022

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 2岁以下婴幼儿几乎100%至少感染过一次RSV，冬春季高发，每年全球约360万名5岁以下儿童因RSV住院。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 是中国2岁以下婴幼儿冬季住院的首要呼吸道病因，6月龄以下小婴儿住院与重症风险最高。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 120一分钟识别与避坑：2岁以下宝宝（尤其<6月龄）出现感冒流涕后迅速转为明显喘憋、呼气带“哮鸣音”、呼吸急促（<2月龄≥60次/分，2–12月龄≥50次/分）、吸气时鼻翼扇动或胸骨/肋间明显凹陷（三凹征）、口周发青、拒奶或尿量明显减少，立即拨打120或急诊就医！家长避坑：1) 抗生素（阿莫西林/头孢）对病毒性毛支完全无效，切勿盲目喂服；2) 严禁给小婴儿喂服成人复方止咳药或镇静剂；3) 住院及居家务必保持鼻腔通畅（生理盐水洗鼻吸涕）。

少量多次喂养防呛咳误吸，必要时静脉补液维持水电解质平衡
冬春流行季避免带6月龄以下婴儿去密闭人群密集场所，家人外出回家先洗手换衣再抱宝宝

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 2023–2024年RSV防控迎来里程碑：1) 长效单抗Nirsevimab（MELODY/HARMONIE III期及真实世界研究）使婴儿RSV相关下呼吸道感染住院降低75%–83%并已在中国上市; 2) 孕妇RSVpreF疫苗（Abrysvo）通过母体接种保护新生儿已获欧美批准; 3) 口服抗RSV小分子药物Ziresovir（齐瑞索韦）在中国III期临床（AIRFLO）中证实可显著改善婴幼儿毛支临床症状评分并降低病毒载量。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 临床尚缺乏已广泛普及的特效口服抗RSV病毒药物，目前住院患儿仍只能“靠氧疗硬扛”; 2) 尼塞韦单抗自费价格偏高，普通足月新生儿家庭可及性有待提高; 3) 婴幼儿重症毛支恢复后未来发生儿童喘息与哮喘的风险显著增加。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 高致死实体瘤微环境破壁与普惠早筛
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 告别“一经发现即晚期”，打破难治肿瘤的免疫屏障

master.definition_en: Hereditary progressive mucinous histiocytosis is a rare, benign, non-Langerhans cell histiocytosis characterized by childhood or adolescence onset of multiple, small, asymptomatic, slowly progressing, skin-colored to red-brown papules with predilection for the face, dorsal hands, forearms and legs, without associated mucosal or visceral involvement. aliases_zh: 肿瘤相关性血栓（CAT）风险状态
curated.category: 遗传性易栓症与凝血障碍
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 由恶性肿瘤、大手术、创伤、长期卧床制动、妊娠/产褥期、口服避孕药、肾病综合征、肝素诱导的血小板减少症（HIT）或重度感染等获得性因素诱发，常处于无症状血栓前状态；一旦在下肢静脉形成血栓并脱落，可在数分钟至数小时内引发致死性大面积肺栓塞（PE），是住院患者及癌症患者最常见可预防死亡原因之一。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 高度可防可控：通过住院VTE风险评分（Caprini/Padua/Khorana）并及时给予低分子肝素、DOAC或机械预防，可大幅降低住院猝死风险；肿瘤相关性血栓（CAT）需在抗栓与高出血风险间精细平衡。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO/GBD未将其单列为死因（死亡归入原发恶性肿瘤、外科并发症及急性肺栓塞）；VTE位居肿瘤患者第二大死因（仅次于原发肿瘤进展），且初诊1年内并发VTE显著增加全因死亡率（PMC12642358）
annual_deaths_global.source: Thrombosis Journal / PMC12642358 & World Thrombosis Day

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国无单列死亡统计；全国多中心住院VTE注册队列证实恶性肿瘤、外科大手术及长期制动是中国住院患者VTE及院内相关死亡最主要获得性诱因（PMC8763586）
annual_deaths_china.source: 《易栓症诊断与防治中国指南》（PMC8763586）/ CAT系统综述（PMC12393071）

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 高危住院与肿瘤患者极常见：活动性肿瘤患者VTE风险较非肿瘤人群升高4–9倍（系统治疗或晚期可达20倍），未筛选肿瘤患者12个月CAT累积发病率约3%–5%（PMC12393071）；大型电子病历队列6个月及12个月累积发病率分别约2.7%与3.7%；未予预防骨科/肿瘤大手术DVT发生率可达15%–40%
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 随老龄化、肿瘤生存期延长及全国医院内VTE防治体系建设推进，中国肿瘤与围术期VTE检出与管理规模持续快速上升

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 入院即行Caprini/Padua或Khorana评分，高危且低出血风险者立即启动预防性LMWH/磺达肝癸钠/低剂量DOAC；若怀疑肝素诱导的血小板减少症（HIT），必须立即停用一切肝素制剂并换用阿加曲班或比伐卢定等非肝素抗凝药；突发肺栓塞按急性PE抢救路径处理。

master.name_en: autosomal dominant Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2 due to KIF5A mutation
master.definition_en: Autosomal dominant Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2 due to KIF5A mutation is a rare form of axonal peripheral sensorimotor neuropathy characterized by classical CMT2 signs and symptoms (progressive weakness and atrophy of distal limb muscles, mild sensory deficits of position, vibration and pain/temperature, pes cavus, and symmetrically absent or reduced muscle and sensory action potentials with relatively preserved nerve conduction velocities in neurophysiological studies) as well as pyramidal tract involvement (spasticity, hyperreflexia). Spasticity and pain may be the presenting symptoms.

master.definition_en: Hereditary glaucoma is a clinically diverse group of rare eye disorders with genetic predisposition characterized by elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) and glaucomatous changes of the optic nerve head, leading to field defects, visual loss and blindness. Hereditary glaucoma can be sub-classified as primary (congenital glaucoma, juvenile glaucoma) or secondary according to the presence or absence of systemic or other ocular anomalies (iridogoniodysgenesis, Stickler syndrome, Coats syndrome). The clinical presentation is variable and is based on age, severity of glaucoma, presence of ocular abnormalities and development of secondary IOP related abnormalities.

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。

master.definition_en: Systemic polyarteritis nodosa (PAN) is a chronic systemic necrotizingvasculitis of adults and childrenaffecting small- and medium-sized vessels and characterized by formation of microaneurysms leading to serious generalized disease and multi-organ involvement.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 神经退行性疾病（渐冻症 ALS、阿尔茨海默病、帕金森）、胶质母细胞瘤与纤维化器官病往往不是没发现靶点，而是大分子药进不去血脑屏障，或普通小分子误伤全身。

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 可穿屏障肽/纳米载体生成式设计、RNA 序列稳定与毒性预测、多组学虚拟细胞扰动响应仿真。

master.definition_en: A rare infectious disease characterized by painful, rapidly progressive infection of deep soft tissue structures. Infections can be mono- or polymicrobial and involve gram-positive cocci, enteric gram-negative bacilli, anaerobes, among others. Fungal infections have also been described in rare cases. Physical examination findings are often subtle and may include erythema, bullae, induration of subcutaneous tissues, and tenderness to palpation.

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

master.definition_en: Roch-Leri mesosomatous lipomatosis is a rare benign autosomal dominant disorder of fat tissue proliferation characterized by the presence of multiple small lipomas of 2 to 5 cm in diameter in the middle third of the body (i.e. the forearms, trunk, and upper thighs), and which are generally painless and can be easily removed by local anesthesia, provided that they are not too numerous or confluent. There have been no further descriptions in the literature since 1984.

master.name_en: combined immunodeficiency due to TBX1 deficiency
master.definition_en: A rare combined immunodeficiency characterized by velo-cardio-facial gestalt (short and narrow palpebral fissures, tubulous nose, small mouth, micrognathia, low-set ears, flattened malar eminences, broad cheeks), congenital heart defect, abnormal thymus and parathyroid, and velopharyngeal insufficiency. Short stature and psychiatric disorders may also present. Developmental and speech delay were reported in few patients. Even though patients carrying TBX1 mutations may manifest clinical features that are overlapping with 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, the presence and frequency of these symptoms significantly differs; not all patients with TBX1 mutations have congenital heart defect, hypocalcemia, psychiatric disorders or developmental delay contrary to 22q11.2 deletion syndrome patients where these features are commonly present.
